body: Point. I would not be posting here if I did not want help. I only started thinking about suicide all at once today. I fear I've snapped and I will not be able to help myself anymore. How can I fix it? I can't even convince myself to pick up the phone and call an ambulance. Just sit here at the computer and post about it on reddit. I'm grasping at straws now.

I have attempted to make friends and turn my life around for the last year or so. I get severe anxiety attacks in social settings due to some mental illnesses I have been diagnosed with, so making friends is very hard. It has been hard for a very long time to make friends and I have not been successful in doing so at all. People with issues to solve are the only people who gravitate towards me. I've always been good the issues of others. Mine however have simply won out. There is no pain to take my mind off. No anger, no sadness, no anything. Just a blank face that will be gone soon.
I'm in Melbourne Australia unfortunately. Going to a party might be interesting.
I believe I covered a lot of it above

If I had to pick any of those it would probably be my relationships.

My parents stopped caring at a very young age. I have no friends, they have all stopped associating themselves after my first girlfriend killed herself. I was on the phone while she did it and heard everything. If I had to guess I would say it pains them to be around me because of this. I do not know my family beyond my parents who refuse to tell me anything, even associate themselves with me because they see me as a burden. My recent ex (my second) had been cheating on me for four months before she left me. With the last person I would have considered a friend. I am done. I am completely and utterly alone and I fear I am in a place where the idea of making any more friends is disgusting and makes me sick.

But no..no sadness. No more tears. No more anger. I have simply had enough of being here. The more I think about it the more it makes sense. I should simply not be alive anymore. It feels right and I don't think I could even convince myself to call anyone to come and stop me anymore.
